Page 101 Cont.
Oct 6 Joanne Allen of Indianapolis - 12 - injured at birth - bright child but has never walked; makes signs and her folks can under- stand ......... Enrolled Today 5.
Helen Heffernan - 30 - of Clinton Ont. Ca. - strept infection given a few hours to live by Prof. John Oyle - head specialist in all Can- ada - "possibly five minutes - clot in main artery of the heart. That was a week ago when her brother-in-law phoned for prayers, etc. ..... improving every day ..... Oct. 12 recovering - Lived four weeks.
Page 102
Oct. 4 Gregor. Affleck - 18 - in Harper Hosp. - fearfully burned - now four days blind - since last Thursday.
Mrs. Marie Smith - and Sister Bernadette - fear cancer ..
Mrs. Mae Parr - 55 - Sault St. Marie Canada - kidney trouble, drop- sey etc. Enrolled by her folks here in Detroit. They rushed up fearing she would be dead .... after being tapped once a week since last of June. Lately seems improving.
5 Lou Landreville - 32 .- in Marine Hospital - back broken thirteen years ago; ten yrs. ago was carried into the Monastery. though that improved slightly at that time. Has been praying earnestly of late to Our Bl. Mother Mary. Has been decidedly improving since. So that we are hopeful that a real miralce may come of the case. En- rolled .... 5. Gave him No. I City of God - Conception.
Anthony Kuczma - 38 - seriously with stomach ulcers. And Mother - 73 - Neuritis and ulcers
Page 103 Oct. 5 Jerry Panik - 6 - peculiar strep-infection now in Ford's Hosp. - Enrolled % phone at 7:20 P.M.
Mrs. Mary Scally - 35 - hemoraging frequently since over a month.
Edmond Quellette Jr. from Belle River Ont. C. - 8 - hurt by a ball when small child-in very bad shape - here again To-night two years developing - Enrolled .. . .
Mrs. Neveda Pope - 45 - baptist - Domestic Troub. - Husband once a Methodist , wants divorce. She herself has never been baptized though she has had her children baptized ... ..
